Name: Compounds Chromatograms
Description: Renders one chromatogram plot per compound and links each plot in the Compounds table. Powered by lcmsPlot.

ScriptProcessorArguments.RequestedTablesAndColumns: Compounds; Compounds per File; Input Files

Parameters.Name: Compounds Query
Parameters.Description: Filter selecting which compounds to plot (evaluated on the compound table; compound_rank 1 = most abundant by area). Empty or NULL plots all compounds.

Parameters.Name: lcmsPlot Source Directory
Parameters.Description: Empty loads the installed lcmsPlot package. Set a path to an lcmsPlot source tree to load that instead (development, via pkgload).

Parameters.Name: Output Directory
Parameters.Description: Directory for the per-compound PNGs. Empty writes to a folder next to the Compound Discoverer result file.

Parameters.Name: Plot DPI
Parameters.Description: Plot resolution in dots per inch.

Parameters.Name: Plot Path Mode
Parameters.Description: Form of the file path stored in the Compounds column: absolute | filename | relative.

Parameters.Name: Plot Column Name
Parameters.Description: Name of the column added to the Compounds table.

Parameters.Name: Plot Column Position After
Parameters.Description: Place the new column after this existing Compounds column.

Parameters.Name: Plot Cell Renderer GUID
Parameters.Description: Compound Discoverer cell renderer for the column (default is the filename/link renderer).
